title: Saying salam
summary: What Muslims say when they meet.

picture.alt: A boy in a white cap waving hello

screens.text: Muslims greet each other with salam.

picture.alt: A boy and a girl meeting and smiling

screens.text: When you meet someone, you say: Assalamu alaykum.

picture.alt: A boy in a white cap waving hello

screens.text: It means: peace be with you.

picture.alt: A white dove, a sign of peace

screens.text: The other person says back: Wa alaykum assalam.

picture.alt: A girl in a hijab smiling and waving back

screens.question: You meet someone. What do you say?
